observations: Three photos show two identical car headlight assemblies placed side by side on a tiled floor.
The headlamps have a modern design with clear lenses, black plastic housings, and integrated turn signals.
Each headlight has a circular main lamp, a smaller auxiliary lamp, and a rectangular amber turn signal section.
The housing appears to be made of black plastic with visible mounting points and electrical connectors.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlamps themselves.
The watermark 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos, suggesting a seller or distributor name.
The photos are taken from slightly different angles, showing the front and side profiles of the headlamps.
No signs of damage or wear are visible on the lenses or housings in the photos.

claims.claim: All models of cars accessories available
claims.evidence: The photos show only one specific headlight assembly; no other accessories are visible. The claim is general and cannot be verified from the images alone.

risks.risk: The headlamps may not fit the buyer's vehicle due to unverified model compatibility.

risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible or for general use only

risks.risk: The headlamps may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., broken internal components, faulty wiring).
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the headlamps turned on, or a close-up of the internal bulb and wiring.

risks.risk: The headlamps may be counterfeit or low-quality replacements.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlamps showing part numbers or a comparison with known genuine models.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the headlamps showing part numbers or mounting points.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
